I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to him on **November 3, 2025**.

That date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025, which said ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". A cutover recap dated Dec 8, 2025 gives the same date.

The recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day through Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on **November 22**. I told him to use Nov 3 as the official date in the CRM. He can add Nov 22 as the operational takeover if the CRM has a field for it.
